title: Poly fill help: Unable to get value of the property 'add': object is null or undefined on IE9.
body:
I need help with IE9 poly fill, where to find and how to use it to avoid the above error.

I installed using npm, algoliasearch: ^3.22.1

comments.body:
You can use any polyfill for `classList` to avoid this error. 

Thanks for using algolia!
